{{Top|leg}}
The '''Garden Hall''' was a hall in the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] hive [[Saras]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Woteba]], built to receive outsiders to the hive.

It was here that [[Raynar Thul|UnuThul]] met with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], [[Saba Sebatyne]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in [[36 ABY]]. At the time, the hall was being overtaken by the [[Fizz (acid)|Fizz]], rendering it useless.
